reasoning: For N sold entries, the only positive pot write makes gross G = N×1,000,000. CashWon is selected exactly when totalEntries < reserveEntries. Its sole settlement helper computes floor(G×8000/10000) for the winner and floor(G×500/10000) for treasury, then assigns G minus both amounts to sponsor. Because 1,000,000 is divisible by 10,000, the reachable results are exactly 80%, 5%, and 15%, with no loss. Both settlement entrypoints converge on this helper; refund, reserve-met, and ignored-callback paths cannot produce an alternative CashWon allocation.
